chapter_title: The Chapter on whether any [Lig]ht comes from the
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:**
Declare concerning this measure of spiritual life and wisdom that proceeds from [GAP-1] the containing forms of divine order that encompass the whole of the regenerating mind [GAP-2] — spiritual life ascends [GAP-3] toward its source.

**¶2:**
[GAP-4] Yet should the [GAP-5] interior perception rise [GAP-6] — the wisdom of divine influx that [GAP-7] — which truths are received inwardly, which illuminate and pass through the great open states of reception, through these entrances of understanding, degree by degree of the mind from outermost to inmost.

**¶3:**
For four states of reception open in each degree of the mind, distributed to the fullness of every quarter of spiritual orientation, opening inward toward the containing forms below. Therefore, on account of this, the [GAP-8] wisdom of divine influx shall enter through these receptive states and it illuminates [GAP-9] that interior degree, and draws upward through them the wisdom and the small [sustaining axis of connection between degrees that] exists there.

**¶4:**
From that interior degree [GAP-10] the purified truth shall be poured [GAP-11] forth into the successive degrees of the heavenly mind. It shall also be refined within those degrees [GAP-12] — a portion is purified of falsity and evil, and it is [GAP-13] wholly raised up into union with the celestial affections that possess genuine life. However, its other portion — [GAP-14] what belongs to self-love and falsity that cannot be purified — shall [GAP-15] be separated and cast down into the lower regions of the mind where such things reside.

---

*Note on ¶4:* This passage describes the universal spiritual process Swedenborg calls *vastation* — the separation that occurs in every degree of regeneration, where what can receive wisdom is drawn upward into heavenly order ("taken up with the living ones") and what resists is rejected downward. The firmaments as successive degrees correspond precisely to the discrete degrees of the mind (natural, spiritual, celestial) through which all influx must pass and be clarified.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [Preac]h about this bit of life and light that comes from [these three] vessels that surround the universe [from which] life comes up [to the light]

[ ... ] b[u]t should the [soul] ascend [to the] light of the rays that [come down] which are received, which shine and go in through these great open gates, through these doors, firmament by firmament.

For four [gates o]pen in each world, distributed at the four points of the compass, opening downwards to the vessels. So, due to this, the [light of the] rays shall go in through these openings and it shines on [that] place, and pulls through them the light and the little pi[llar (?) that ex]ists there.

From that place [it] shall be poured [out to the] firmaments. It shall also be clarified in these firmaments [so that] a part there is cleansed and it is [all] taken up with the living ones. However, its other part [that cannot be cleansed] shall all [be cast] down.

fills.explanation: The three vessels (Sun, Moon, Stars) are the standard Manichaean cosmic containers that purify light — "these three" correctly identifies them before the noun "vessels."
The relative clause "from which" connects the vessels (containing forms) to the ascending life, indicating light proceeds upward from these cosmic stations.
The spiritual reading says life ascends "toward its source," which in Manichaean cosmological vocabulary is "the light" — the Realm of Light as the origin and goal of all ascending life.

The spiritual reading identifies "interior perception" as what ascends; in the Kephalaia's register, the "living soul" (psyche) is the interior light-substance that ascends through the cosmic mechanism.

Bridges "ascend" to "light of the rays" — the soul ascends to receive the light of the descending rays, indicating the meeting point between ascending interior perception and descending divine influx.
The rays descend from above to be received at the gates of each firmament — "come down" describes the influx direction before the rays "are received" and "shine and go in through" the gates.
The spiritual reading confirms "wisdom of divine influx" which in the Kephalaia's natural register is "light of the" rays — light corresponds to wisdom, rays to influx.
The spiritual reading confirms "that interior degree" — the demonstrative "that" points to the specific place/degree where the light shines and draws up the light within.
The spiritual reading confirms "the purified truth shall be poured" — "it" is the pronoun referring back to the gathered light/truth from the preceding clause.
The spiritual reading confirms "forth into the successive degrees" — "out to the" firmaments describes the purified light being poured forth into the next successive degrees.
The spiritual reading shows a purpose/result relationship between clarification in the firmaments and the cleansing of a portion — "so that" expresses this causal connection.
The spiritual reading confirms "wholly raised up" — "all" as an intensifier meaning "wholly/entirely" correctly expresses the complete elevation of the purified portion.

The spiritual reading specifies "what belongs to self-love and falsity that cannot be purified" — in the Kephalaia's register this is "that cannot be cleansed," directly contrasting with the portion that "is cleansed" in the preceding clause.
The spiritual reading confirms "be separated and cast down" — "be cast" down is the standard Kephalaia expression for the rejection of impure matter/darkness in the vastation process.
